purpose: Convert DNA/RNA PDB or PDBx/mmCIF coordinates to core CIF with residue-aware nucleotide atom recognition and optional linear backbone traces. Export chain-aware O3-prime graphs as Systre CRYSTAL CGD and native ChimeraX marker/link views. Optionally stitch backbone nicks and stacking junctions across chains and symmetry images using NAtopo's P...O3' join and non-backbone pi-stack rules.
standing_user_requirements: Installable after every substantial patch, not only at formal releases.
Maintain clear human-readable and machine-readable intent in the repository.
CGD export keeps chains separate by default; opt-in --stitch-nicks and --stitch-junctions add NAtopo-rule joins and report every unstitched candidate.
Publish as an independent vecchioni-lab Git repository named TopoStich.

input.model_selection: one-based file encounter order, default first

outputs.reference_policy: self-contained coordinates and edges; source SHA-256 and basename are provenance
outputs.pdb_precision: 0.001 A coordinates; 0.01 occupancy/B. Refuse field overflow.

explicit_all_atoms.behavior: same as no atom flags; all atoms in selected model, respecting an explicit --altloc

selection.no_atom_flags: all atoms; preserve explicit CONECT and unambiguous same-image struct_conn links; report unsupported image/unresolved mmCIF links
selection.residue_order: input file order; numbering and insertion codes are identities, not sorting keys
selection.missing_atom_policy: skip and bridge within existing segment
selection.alternate_locations: preserved in all-atom conversion; explicit choice required for selected trace

crystallography.coordinate_policy: fractionalize without wrapping, minimizing, or changing the lattice
crystallography.scale_policy: precise cell for conventional PDB-rounded matrices; retain full-precision native mmCIF matrices and nonzero shifts
crystallography.symmetry_policy: copy declared PDB/mmCIF fractional operations; otherwise retain symbol and report
crystallography.graph_policy: explicit endpoint links; no distance-based perception or chemical bond-order inference, except the opt-in NAtopo nick and junction screens in topostich-cgd

quality_gates: packaged lookup data present after clean install
native mmCIF installed CLI smoke test
stitching and junction regressions; installed --stitch-nicks/--stitch-junctions smoke checks

external_validation.Systre: 19.6.0 native parser, node degrees, consecutive labels and finite component checks passed for 8D93; cosine-roundoff cell warning diagnosed; no net identification. 0.4.0: tools/check_stitched_cgd.py passed 85 stitched/unstitched exports of 17 crystals with Systre 19.6.0 (edge counts match receipts).
external_validation.ChimeraX: 1.12 (2026-06-12): native CMM import passed for both 8D93 views, including all nodes, links and notes.

recognition.lookup: residue code -> canonical role -> actual observed atom name
recognition.source: NARestraints/restraints/data/Ligands.xlsx working snapshot; SHA-256 recorded in catalog
recognition.duplicate_policy: most distinct observed mapped names; retain unresolved ties
recognition.extra_sugar_atoms: recognized internally; no new CLI trace order

cgd_export.dialect: CRYSTAL block, named source node plus fractional neighbor-image coordinates
cgd_export.representation: One nucleotide is represented by one node at its observed O3-prime atom coordinate; no base centroid or fitted pseudoatom.
cgd_export.coordinates: Fractional coordinates in the declared cell; retain negative and greater-than-one neighbor coordinates to identify the intended periodic image.
cgd_export.node_degree: Actual incident edge count; special positions rejected pending stabilizer-aware support.
cgd_export.graph: Explicit consecutive retained O3-prime nodes within each original segment. With --stitch-nicks, additional periodic edges for one-to-one backbone nick joins between segment termini, in any symmetry/lattice image. With --stitch-junctions, periodic edges for NAtopo junction stacks (face scope by default).
pending: Reviewed confirm/remove decisions for ambiguous nicks and junctions
cgd_export.existing_missing_atom_policy: Continue skipping missing selected O3-prime atoms and bridging within the original strand segment; no invented coordinates.
cgd_export.position_guard: Reject special positions and symmetry overlaps within a conservative 0.003 per conventional fractional coordinate, modulo translations.

views.symmetry: --crystal-cmm, intact conventional symmetry copies, separate models; nick joins and junction stacks in their own models

nick_stitching.rule_source: NAtopo nucleotide_interactions.find_backbone_join_candidates + prepare_nucleotides loose-end rules + build_atom_graph polymer links
nick_stitching.loose_P: P with own O5' and no inter-residue covalent neighbor
nick_stitching.loose_O3: O3' with own C3' and no inter-residue covalent neighbor
nick_stitching.existing_link: consecutive O3'-P 0.8-2.2 A within a segment, or explicit input link 0.8-2.3 A
nick_stitching.join: loose P...loose O3' < 3.5 A on a different chain copy (other segment or other image)
nick_stitching.o5_fallback: phosphate-less O5' (own C5') ... loose O3' < 6.0 A; reported only unless --include-o5-fallback
nick_stitching.image_search: exact: all conventional operations incl. centering, all lattice translations within the cutoff
nick_stitching.acceptance: stitch only one-to-one joins between segment 3-prime and 5-prime termini; otherwise report status
nick_stitching.edge_convention: source = 3-prime end node at stored position; target = 5-prime strand's first O3-prime node in image g=operation+n; reciprocal row uses g inverse
nick_stitching.natopo_cross_validation: identical candidate orbits, images and distances on 17 local nucleic-acid crystals (2026-11-11)

junction_stitching.base_plane: SVD plane of complete ring heavy atoms (9 purine, 6 pyrimidine); ring names from the packaged NARestraints catalog
junction_stitching.pi_stack: centroids < 5.5 A, normals within 30 deg, both separations 2.0-4.5 A, both lateral shifts <= 3.0 A
junction_stitching.junction: pi stack not joined by a verified O3-prime-P bond in the same image
junction_stitching.face_reason: stack_on_face_without_backbone_continuation when every verified backbone neighbor of an endpoint lies on the opposite face (0.5 A tolerance)
junction_stitching.natopo_cross_validation: identical junction orbits, images, reasons, distances and excluded-stack counts on 17 local crystals (2026-11-11)

cgd_export.native_audit: tools/check_stitched_cgd.py (+ tools/CheckCgd.java --stitched); CheckCgd default mode is the unstitched baseline
